{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'converted' column
converted_distribution = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the 'customer_age' column for any implausible values
age_stats = sales_df['customer_age'].describe()

# Print results
missing_values, duplicates, converted_distribution, age_stats"}
